description: ASTM A249 TP 304L Boiler Tubes are made from a low carbon version of the 304 material. The material has 18% chromium and 8% nickel in the composition. This composition provides the pipes with high corrosion resistance and strength. The Stainless Steel 304L Pipe has high melting point of 1350 degrees Celsius and it can withstand high temperatures as well. The material composition also includes carbon, silicon, manganese, sulfur and phosphorus. The composition provides the material with 205 MPa minimum yield strength and 415 MPa tensile strength. The pipes range in diameter from ½ inches to 36 inches. There are seamless, ERW and EFW pipe types. The stainless steel 304l Welded Tubing is also available. The welded pipes and tubes are made from sheets, foils, coils and plates of the same grade of material by welding them end to end.

There are different forms such as round, square, rectangular and hydraulic types. The DIN 1.4301 Round Pipe is the most used and is cost efficient. The 304l material also has lower carbon and reduces the possibilities of grain formation during welding. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment after welding. The 304L Stainless Steel Heat Exchanger Tubes are used in heat exchangers. The pipes can also be seen in power generation plants, nuclear power plants, oil and gas, petrochemical and in other general engineering applications.

description: AISI 316h Tube is a high carbon version of the 316 material. There are pipes and tube made up of this material that are corrosion resistant and strong. The material includes 18% chromium, 8% nickel, 4% molybdenum along with sulfur, phosphorus, silicon and manganese. The Stainless Steel 316 Pipegets its corrosion resistance from the chromium, nickel, molybdenum composition. The material is corrosion resistant to brackish water, sea water and chloride ions. There are tubes and pipes ranging from ¼ inches to 36 inches in outer diameter. The 1.4429 Aisi 316LN Tubingcan be used at high temperatures because of the high melting point of 1400 degrees Celsius. The pipes and tubes also have 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength which make them applicable for stronger needs.

The pipes come in round, square, rectangular shapes and in seamless, welded, cold drawn, structural, hot finished, extruded or annealed conditions. The AISI 316 Stainless Steel ERW Pipe can rang above 36 inches in diameter. The wall thickness of the pipes range from 0.4mm to 30mm with schedules ranging from sch5 through XXH. The high carbon content of the pipes make them tougher to withstand high wear and tear. Since there is high carbon, preheating is required to eliminate carbide precipitation and grain formation. The Stainless Steel Type 316ln Welded Pipe comes in lengths up to 6.1m with custom cut to length sizes. The applications are in the marine, wastewater management, food processing, power generation and in oil and gas industrial applications.

description: Schedule 10 AISI 316L Tube is mad up of a low carbon version of the 316 material. The 316 material is corrosion resistant, particularly to chloride ion. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe is used in structural applications to provide extra strength. The material is made up of sulfur, phosphorus, silicon, manganese, 18% chromium, 8% nickel and 4% molybdenum in the composition. This composition provides the material with 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength. The pipes range from ¼ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes and up to 48 inches for ERW pipe type. There are seamless, ERW, welded and other types of production methods. The UNS S31603 Welded Pipe is stronger but has high absolute roughness compared to the seamless pipes.

The seamless pipes have much smoother surfaces with accurate dimensions. The pipes can vary in thickness from 0.4mm to 30mm. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe can have schedules ranging from sch5 through XXS. The material has high melting point of 1400 degrees Celsius. The high pressure capacities, corrosion resistance, strength and the high melting point allow the pipe to be used under high temperature, high pressure services. The stainless steel 316L seamless pipe is easy to weld upon due to the low carbon content. No filler materials or preheating is required for welding. The applications such as oil and gas, power generation, heat exchanger, boiler, sea water, marine, ship building and others use these pipes for the corrosion resistance, strength and cost effectiveness.

description: W. Nr. 1.4541 Welded Pipe has good forming and welding characteristics. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment. It can also withstand high temperatures up to 900 degrees Celsius. The material is used in high strength, high temperature applications and is not used for decorative purposes usually. The AISI 321H Boiler & Heat Exhanger Tubes are used in annealing covers, high temperature tempering equipment, chemical processing equipment, automotive exhaust systems, firewalls, boiler casings, aircraft exhaust stacks and manifolds, superheaters, gas and oil refinery equipment and so on. The Stainless Steel 321 Pipe is made up of 17% chromium, 9% nickel, silicon, iron, titanium, phosphorus and sulfur in the composition. The pipe sizes range from 1/8 inches to 48 inches and the seamless pipes range only up to 24 inches.

There are different shapes such as round, square, rectangular and others. The wall thickness of the pipes range from 0.4mm to 30mm and the schedules range from sch5 through XXH. The length of the pipes range up to 6.1m and custom cut to lengths are available as well. There are seamless, welded, cold drawn, structural, hot finished, extruded, annealed and pickled types. The AISI 321 Seamless Pipe is the most used type and it has less absolute roughness which means the dimensions are precise. The material has 1454 degrees Celsius melting point, 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength. The 321 Stainless Steel Exhaust Tubing is therefore used in high temperature applications with high corrosion resistance requirements.

description: Steel is measured by its grade based on its thickness, physical properties, and oxidation state. Stainless steel 310 pipe is widely used in various industries due to its high chromium and nickel content. This makes it resistant to oxidation, corrosion, and sulfidation. 310s stainless steel pipe is a lower carbon version of the 310 stainless steel pipe. Both the pipes are widely used in petroleum refining, steam boilers, food-processing equipment, etc. We are one of the top Stainless steel 310 pipe manufactures in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

When exposed to high temperatures as well as at sub-zero temperatures, the ASTM A312 TP 310 Welded Pipe is able to maintain its shape as well as its strength. These pipes are prepared using the latest technology and high-quality raw materials by our renowned staff. On the other hand, the ASTM A213 TP310S Seamless Tube is treated at 1010- 1150°C thereby, making it resistant to corrosion. Furthermore, the presence of carbon makes the pipe resistant to sensitization.

If you are looking for a pipe to handle heavy-duty applications, then the SS 310S schedule 40 pipe will do your bidding. The heavy-duty walls on this pipe are known as schedule. The smooth interior makes it another 310 pipe, which is resistant to corrosion and safe from the wrath of nature. Our team also grooves, cuts ASME B36.10 SS 310S Round Pipe according to your requirements. This standard specified seamless and welded steel pipes size ranges from NPS 1/8 to NPS 80, and the grooves on the pipe are either cut or rolled.

description: Alloy 317 is made up of molybdenum, which consists of low carbon austenitic stainless steel. Stainless steel 317L pipe is made up of this strong alloy that has high resistance to corrosion and chemical attacks. These pipes, especially the Stainless Steel 317L Welded Pipe, performs well under extreme temperatures and resist distortion. These pipes are; widely used in paper and pulp equipment, food processing, power generation operations, textile factories, chemical, petrochemical processing units, etc. For many years we, have been one of the top SS 317l pipe manufactures who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A269 TP317L Seamless Tube provides excellent resistance when the containment is, desired to be as minimal as possible. The pipe is prepared in heat-treated conditions with flaring, flange, hardness, and reverse flattening tests performed to ensure high-quality pipes are available at your disposal. The ASTM A269 TP 317 Heat Exchanger Tube is U-shaped and is specially manufactured for heat exchangers. These pipes are made up of manganese, nickel, chromium, silicon, carbon, phosphorous, sulfur, and molybdenum components thereby making them highly resistant to intergranular corrosion and high temperatures. This pipe covers tubes and pipes in boilers, superheaters, heat exchangers, and condenser tubes.

We also produce SS 317L schedule 40 pipe which lasts for many years as they are prepared using the best raw materials and latest technology by our best in the market staff. These pipes are mostly used to handle heavy-duty applications. These pipes: can be cut, grooved, or customized as per your choosing and are usually have a standard thickness of 0.3mm – 50 mm.

meta.keywords: Stainless Steel 904L Pipe, stainless steel 904l tubes, 904l stainless steel pipe, 904l pipe, 904l stainless steel tube, 904l steel tube, 904l tube, ss 904l tube

description: AISI 904L Heat Exchanger Tube is made up of a low carbon high alloy material that has good strength and corrosion resistance properties. The material is made up of carbon, manganese, 23% nickel, 19% chromium, sulfur, 4% molybdenum, nitrogen, copper, phosphorus and silicon in the composition. The UNS N08904 Round Pipe is the most used shape where there are square, rectangular and hydraulic pipes. The material is especially corrosion resistant against brackish water and chloride ion. The pipes can range in wall thickness from 04mm to 30mm and schedules sch5 through XXH. The Stainless Steel 904L Pipe is one of the medium schedule pipes. These can be used with medium pressure applications. The pipes can range in dimensions with outer diameters ranging from ½ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes, ½ inches to 36 inches for ERW pipe and from 6 inches to 100 inches for the EFW pipe types.

The pipes can come with different pipe ends such as plain, beveled and treaded. The ASTM B677 TP 904L SS Seamless Pipes have high dimensional accuracy and are used in tools and equipment. The material has good strength with 490 MPa minimum tensile strength and 220 MPa minimum yield strength. With the corrosion resistance, strength and good elongation of 35% at break, the material is also used in making the SS 904L Capillary Tubes which are used in low volume precision applications. The applications of the pipes and tubes could be seen in boilers, heat exchangers, super heater elements, chemical processing, food processing, ship building, sea water and other general corrosive services as well.

description: ASTM A249 TP 304L Boiler Tubes are made from a low carbon version of the 304 material. The material has 18% chromium and 8% nickel in the composition. This composition provides the pipes with high corrosion resistance and strength. The Stainless Steel 304L Pipe has high melting point of 1350 degrees Celsius and it can withstand high temperatures as well. The material composition also includes carbon, silicon, manganese, sulfur and phosphorus. The composition provides the material with 205 MPa minimum yield strength and 415 MPa tensile strength. The pipes range in diameter from ½ inches to 36 inches. There are seamless, ERW and EFW pipe types. The stainless steel 304l Welded Tubing is also available. The welded pipes and tubes are made from sheets, foils, coils and plates of the same grade of material by welding them end to end.

There are different forms such as round, square, rectangular and hydraulic types. The DIN 1.4301 Round Pipe is the most used and is cost efficient. The 304l material also has lower carbon and reduces the possibilities of grain formation during welding. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment after welding. The 304L Stainless Steel Heat Exchanger Tubes are used in heat exchangers. The pipes can also be seen in power generation plants, nuclear power plants, oil and gas, petrochemical and in other general engineering applications.

description: AISI 316h Tube is a high carbon version of the 316 material. There are pipes and tube made up of this material that are corrosion resistant and strong. The material includes 18% chromium, 8% nickel, 4% molybdenum along with sulfur, phosphorus, silicon and manganese. The Stainless Steel 316 Pipegets its corrosion resistance from the chromium, nickel, molybdenum composition. The material is corrosion resistant to brackish water, sea water and chloride ions. There are tubes and pipes ranging from ¼ inches to 36 inches in outer diameter. The 1.4429 Aisi 316LN Tubingcan be used at high temperatures because of the high melting point of 1400 degrees Celsius. The pipes and tubes also have 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength which make them applicable for stronger needs.

The pipes come in round, square, rectangular shapes and in seamless, welded, cold drawn, structural, hot finished, extruded or annealed conditions. The AISI 316 Stainless Steel ERW Pipe can rang above 36 inches in diameter. The wall thickness of the pipes range from 0.4mm to 30mm with schedules ranging from sch5 through XXH. The high carbon content of the pipes make them tougher to withstand high wear and tear. Since there is high carbon, preheating is required to eliminate carbide precipitation and grain formation. The Stainless Steel Type 316ln Welded Pipe comes in lengths up to 6.1m with custom cut to length sizes. The applications are in the marine, wastewater management, food processing, power generation and in oil and gas industrial applications.

description: Schedule 10 AISI 316L Tube is mad up of a low carbon version of the 316 material. The 316 material is corrosion resistant, particularly to chloride ion. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe is used in structural applications to provide extra strength. The material is made up of sulfur, phosphorus, silicon, manganese, 18% chromium, 8% nickel and 4% molybdenum in the composition. This composition provides the material with 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength. The pipes range from ¼ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes and up to 48 inches for ERW pipe type. There are seamless, ERW, welded and other types of production methods. The UNS S31603 Welded Pipe is stronger but has high absolute roughness compared to the seamless pipes.

The seamless pipes have much smoother surfaces with accurate dimensions. The pipes can vary in thickness from 0.4mm to 30mm. The Stainless Steel 316L Pipe can have schedules ranging from sch5 through XXS. The material has high melting point of 1400 degrees Celsius. The high pressure capacities, corrosion resistance, strength and the high melting point allow the pipe to be used under high temperature, high pressure services. The stainless steel 316L seamless pipe is easy to weld upon due to the low carbon content. No filler materials or preheating is required for welding. The applications such as oil and gas, power generation, heat exchanger, boiler, sea water, marine, ship building and others use these pipes for the corrosion resistance, strength and cost effectiveness.

description: W. Nr. 1.4541 Welded Pipe has good forming and welding characteristics. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment. It can also withstand high temperatures up to 900 degrees Celsius. The material is used in high strength, high temperature applications and is not used for decorative purposes usually. The AISI 321H Boiler & Heat Exhanger Tubes are used in annealing covers, high temperature tempering equipment, chemical processing equipment, automotive exhaust systems, firewalls, boiler casings, aircraft exhaust stacks and manifolds, superheaters, gas and oil refinery equipment and so on. The Stainless Steel 321 Pipe is made up of 17% chromium, 9% nickel, silicon, iron, titanium, phosphorus and sulfur in the composition. The pipe sizes range from 1/8 inches to 48 inches and the seamless pipes range only up to 24 inches.

There are different shapes such as round, square, rectangular and others. The wall thickness of the pipes range from 0.4mm to 30mm and the schedules range from sch5 through XXH. The length of the pipes range up to 6.1m and custom cut to lengths are available as well. There are seamless, welded, cold drawn, structural, hot finished, extruded, annealed and pickled types. The AISI 321 Seamless Pipe is the most used type and it has less absolute roughness which means the dimensions are precise. The material has 1454 degrees Celsius melting point, 515 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength. The 321 Stainless Steel Exhaust Tubing is therefore used in high temperature applications with high corrosion resistance requirements.

description: Steel is measured by its grade based on its thickness, physical properties, and oxidation state. Stainless steel 310 pipe is widely used in various industries due to its high chromium and nickel content. This makes it resistant to oxidation, corrosion, and sulfidation. 310s stainless steel pipe is a lower carbon version of the 310 stainless steel pipe. Both the pipes are widely used in petroleum refining, steam boilers, food-processing equipment, etc. We are one of the top Stainless steel 310 pipe manufactures in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

When exposed to high temperatures as well as at sub-zero temperatures, the ASTM A312 TP 310 Welded Pipe is able to maintain its shape as well as its strength. These pipes are prepared using the latest technology and high-quality raw materials by our renowned staff. On the other hand, the ASTM A213 TP310S Seamless Tube is treated at 1010- 1150°C thereby, making it resistant to corrosion. Furthermore, the presence of carbon makes the pipe resistant to sensitization.

If you are looking for a pipe to handle heavy-duty applications, then the SS 310S schedule 40 pipe will do your bidding. The heavy-duty walls on this pipe are known as schedule. The smooth interior makes it another 310 pipe, which is resistant to corrosion and safe from the wrath of nature. Our team also grooves, cuts ASME B36.10 SS 310S Round Pipe according to your requirements. This standard specified seamless and welded steel pipes size ranges from NPS 1/8 to NPS 80, and the grooves on the pipe are either cut or rolled.

description: Alloy 317 is made up of molybdenum, which consists of low carbon austenitic stainless steel. Stainless steel 317L pipe is made up of this strong alloy that has high resistance to corrosion and chemical attacks. These pipes, especially the Stainless Steel 317L Welded Pipe, performs well under extreme temperatures and resist distortion. These pipes are; widely used in paper and pulp equipment, food processing, power generation operations, textile factories, chemical, petrochemical processing units, etc. For many years we, have been one of the top SS 317l pipe manufactures who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A269 TP317L Seamless Tube provides excellent resistance when the containment is, desired to be as minimal as possible. The pipe is prepared in heat-treated conditions with flaring, flange, hardness, and reverse flattening tests performed to ensure high-quality pipes are available at your disposal. The ASTM A269 TP 317 Heat Exchanger Tube is U-shaped and is specially manufactured for heat exchangers. These pipes are made up of manganese, nickel, chromium, silicon, carbon, phosphorous, sulfur, and molybdenum components thereby making them highly resistant to intergranular corrosion and high temperatures. This pipe covers tubes and pipes in boilers, superheaters, heat exchangers, and condenser tubes.

We also produce SS 317L schedule 40 pipe which lasts for many years as they are prepared using the best raw materials and latest technology by our best in the market staff. These pipes are mostly used to handle heavy-duty applications. These pipes: can be cut, grooved, or customized as per your choosing and are usually have a standard thickness of 0.3mm – 50 mm.

description: AISI 904L Heat Exchanger Tube is made up of a low carbon high alloy material that has good strength and corrosion resistance properties. The material is made up of carbon, manganese, 23% nickel, 19% chromium, sulfur, 4% molybdenum, nitrogen, copper, phosphorus and silicon in the composition. The UNS N08904 Round Pipe is the most used shape where there are square, rectangular and hydraulic pipes. The material is especially corrosion resistant against brackish water and chloride ion. The pipes can range in wall thickness from 04mm to 30mm and schedules sch5 through XXH. The Stainless Steel 904L Pipe is one of the medium schedule pipes. These can be used with medium pressure applications. The pipes can range in dimensions with outer diameters ranging from ½ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes, ½ inches to 36 inches for ERW pipe and from 6 inches to 100 inches for the EFW pipe types.

The pipes can come with different pipe ends such as plain, beveled and treaded. The ASTM B677 TP 904L SS Seamless Pipes have high dimensional accuracy and are used in tools and equipment. The material has good strength with 490 MPa minimum tensile strength and 220 MPa minimum yield strength. With the corrosion resistance, strength and good elongation of 35% at break, the material is also used in making the SS 904L Capillary Tubes which are used in low volume precision applications. The applications of the pipes and tubes could be seen in boilers, heat exchangers, super heater elements, chemical processing, food processing, ship building, sea water and other general corrosive services as well.

description: ASTM A249 TP 304L Boiler Tubes are made from a low carbon version of the 304 material. The material has 18% chromium and 8% nickel in the composition. This composition provides the pipes with high corrosion resistance and strength. The Stainless Steel 304L Pipe has high melting point of 1350 degrees Celsius and it can withstand high temperatures as well. The material composition also includes carbon, silicon, manganese, sulfur and phosphorus. The composition provides the material with 205 MPa minimum yield strength and 415 MPa tensile strength. The pipes range in diameter from ½ inches to 36 inches. There are seamless, ERW and EFW pipe types. The stainless steel 304l Welded Tubing is also available. The welded pipes and tubes are made from sheets, foils, coils and plates of the same grade of material by welding them end to end.

There are different forms such as round, square, rectangular and hydraulic types. The DIN 1.4301 Round Pipe is the most used and is cost efficient. The 304l material also has lower carbon and reduces the possibilities of grain formation during welding. The material does not require pre heating or post weld heat treatment after welding. The 304L Stainless Steel Heat Exchanger Tubes are used in heat exchangers. The pipes can also be seen in power generation plants, nuclear power plants, oil and gas, petrochemical and in other general engineering applications.

The material is made up of sulfur, phosphorus, silicon, manganese, 18% chromium, 8% nickel and 4% molybdenum in the composition. The pipes range from ¼ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes and up to 48 inches for ERW pipe type. There are seamless, ERW, welded and other types of production methods. The stainless steel 316L seamless pipe is easy to weld upon due to the low carbon content. No filler materials or preheating is required for welding. The applications such as oil and gas, power generation, heat exchanger, boiler, sea water, marine, ship building and others use these pipes for the corrosion resistance, strength and cost effectiveness.

meta.keywords: stainless steel 310 pipe, grade 310 stainless steel pipe, ss 310 pipe, ss 310 seamless pipe, 310s stainless steel pipe, 310s pipe, 310 stainless steel tubing, 310 stainless steel square tubing

description: Steel is measured by its grade based on its thickness, physical properties, and oxidation state. Stainless steel 310 pipe is widely used in various industries due to its high chromium and nickel content. This makes it resistant to oxidation, corrosion, and sulfidation. 310s stainless steel pipe is a lower carbon version of the 310 stainless steel pipe. Both the pipes are widely used in petroleum refining, steam boilers, food-processing equipment, etc. We are one of the top Stainless steel 310 pipe manufactures in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

When exposed to high temperatures as well as at sub-zero temperatures, the ASTM A312 TP 310 Welded Pipe is able to maintain its shape as well as its strength. These pipes are prepared using the latest technology and high-quality raw materials by our renowned staff. On the other hand, the ASTM A213 TP310S Seamless Tube is treated at 1010- 1150°C thereby, making it resistant to corrosion. Furthermore, the presence of carbon makes the pipe resistant to sensitization.

If you are looking for a pipe to handle heavy-duty applications, then the SS 310S schedule 40 pipe will do your bidding. The heavy-duty walls on this pipe are known as schedule. The smooth interior makes it another 310 pipe, which is resistant to corrosion and safe from the wrath of nature. Our team also grooves, cuts ASME B36.10 SS 310S Round Pipe according to your requirements. This standard specified seamless and welded steel pipes size ranges from NPS 1/8 to NPS 80, and the grooves on the pipe are either cut or rolled.

meta.description: We are Biggest Stainless Steel 317L Pipe Supplier in India, We Specialize In Offering ASTM A269 TP317L Seamless/ Welded Tube, Check online UNS S31700 Round Pipe Size Chart.
meta.keywords: 317l stainless steel pipe, 317l stainless steel tubing, 317l stainless steel tube, ss 317l pipe, ss 317l tube

description: Alloy 317 is made up of molybdenum, which consists of low carbon austenitic stainless steel. Stainless steel 317L pipe is made up of this strong alloy that has high resistance to corrosion and chemical attacks. These pipes, especially the Stainless Steel 317L Welded Pipe, performs well under extreme temperatures and resist distortion. These pipes are; widely used in paper and pulp equipment, food processing, power generation operations, textile factories, chemical, petrochemical processing units, etc. For many years we, have been one of the top SS 317l pipe manufactures who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A269 TP317L Seamless Tube provides excellent resistance when the containment is, desired to be as minimal as possible. The pipe is prepared in heat-treated conditions with flaring, flange, hardness, and reverse flattening tests performed to ensure high-quality pipes are available at your disposal. The ASTM A269 TP 317 Heat Exchanger Tube is U-shaped and is specially manufactured for heat exchangers. These pipes are made up of manganese, nickel, chromium, silicon, carbon, phosphorous, sulfur, and molybdenum components thereby making them highly resistant to intergranular corrosion and high temperatures. This pipe covers tubes and pipes in boilers, superheaters, heat exchangers, and condenser tubes.

We also produce SS 317L schedule 40 pipe which lasts for many years as they are prepared using the best raw materials and latest technology by our best in the market staff. These pipes are mostly used to handle heavy-duty applications. These pipes: can be cut, grooved, or customized as per your choosing and are usually have a standard thickness of 0.3mm – 50 mm.

description: AISI 904L Heat Exchanger Tube is made up of a low carbon high alloy material that has good strength and corrosion resistance properties. The material is made up of carbon, manganese, 23% nickel, 19% chromium, sulfur, 4% molybdenum, nitrogen, copper, phosphorus and silicon in the composition. The UNS N08904 Round Pipe is the most used shape where there are square, rectangular and hydraulic pipes. The material is especially corrosion resistant against brackish water and chloride ion. The pipes can range in wall thickness from 04mm to 30mm and schedules sch5 through XXH. The Stainless Steel 904L Pipe is one of the medium schedule pipes. These can be used with medium pressure applications. The pipes can range in dimensions with outer diameters ranging from ½ inches to 24 inches for seamless pipes, ½ inches to 36 inches for ERW pipe and from 6 inches to 100 inches for the EFW pipe types.

The pipes can come with different pipe ends such as plain, beveled and treaded. The ASTM B677 TP 904L SS Seamless Pipes have high dimensional accuracy and are used in tools and equipment. The material has good strength with 490 MPa minimum tensile strength and 220 MPa minimum yield strength. With the corrosion resistance, strength and good elongation of 35% at break, the material is also used in making the SS 904L Capillary Tubes which are used in low volume precision applications. The applications of the pipes and tubes could be seen in boilers, heat exchangers, super heater elements, chemical processing, food processing, ship building, sea water and other general corrosive services as well.

description: ASTM A269 304 High Precision Tubes are covered by the specification for seamless and welded austenitic steel tubing for general corrosion resisting and low or high temperature service with specific wall thicknesses. The pipes under this grade and specification shall be heat treated for best hardness. The SS Heat Capillary Pipe tubes are made with very low outer diameters and wall thicknesses. The capillary tubes are used to pass expensive fluids through precise pipelines with high efficiency. We are leading Stainless Steel Capillary Tube Supplier in India. The seamless pipes and tubes are mostly cold drawn and have high precision in their dimensions. The 304 SS Flow Capillary Pipe is made up of the most used austenitic stainless steel with 18% chromium, 8% nickel and carbon, sulfur, silicon and phosphorus in the composition.

The material is strong with 515 MPa minimum tensile strength, 205 MPa minimum yield strength and up to 870 degrees temperature capable for intermittent services. There are also tubes with high wall thicknesses such as the Pressure Gauge Capillary Tube. These tubes have high wall thickness, yet low outer diameter which makes them withstand high pressures. So they can work in the high pressure gauges to control the fluid flow. The pressure gauge tubes are used in other applications in tools and equipment as well. The Narrow Capillary Tube is used inside engines and tools to pass fluids for shorter distances and in lower volumes but under high pressures. There are different stainless steel grades from which these tubes could be made. Depending on the grade of the tubes, the applications vary and their mechanical properties vary as well.

description: 316 SS Coil Tubing Heat Exchanger tubes are made especially for heat exchanger applications. The tubes are coiled to increase the material flow length within a given space. This is useful in heating up fluids within a short distance. The 304 stainless steel coiled tubing is placed under warm water, hot air or inside heating champers so that the fluids inside the coil get heated faster. The coil tubing has to have precise dimensions, high corrosion resistance and high temperature resistance. We are biggest Stainless Steel Coiled Tubing Supplier in India . The 304 material has good strength and high temperature resistance up to 870 degrees Celsius. There are different types such as the 1/2 coiled stainless steel tubing which are in the form of a half coil.

There are different material grades that are used for the coiled tubing for heat exchangers, boilers, super heaters and other high temperature applications that involve heating or cooling. The different types include the 3/8 coiled stainless steel tubing as well. Depending on the nature of the application, the nature of fluid that is being transmitted through the tubes and the material grades, these types of tubes differ. There are two different dimensions for the coiled tubes as the diameter of the tube and the diameter of the coil, the length, wall thickness and the schedules. The SS Coil Tubes are used in different dimensions and grades depending on the application requirements. There are high alloy materials and other carbon steel materials that are available for the coil tubing as well.

meta.keywords: API 5L Seamless Pipe, api 5l seamless pipe, api 5l pipes, api 5l grade b pipe, api 5l-b pipe material, API 5l line pipe, API 5l pipe, API 5l dsaw pipe, API 5l carbon steel pipe, API 5l psl2 pipe, API 5l psl1 pipe, API 5l steel pipe, API 5l schedule 40 pipe, API 5l schedule 80 pipe

description: API 5L Schedule 40 Pipe comes in different grades within the API 5L specification. The pipes also have different product specification levels PSL1 and PSL 2 in each grade. The various grades are A, B, X42, X46 and up to X70. All these are used as line pipes to transport fluids over long distances. The API 5L DSAW Line Pipe is made up of carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, vanadium, niobium and titanium in the composition in varying amounts depending on the different grades. These are basically carbon steel pipes that can be used in high toughness, high wear and tear and high strength application requirements.

The yield strength of the pipes are denominated by the X number of the pipes in ksi. For example, the API 5L Carbon Steel Seamless Pipe belonging to the grade X42 has 42ksi minimum yield strength and X70 has 70 ksi minimum yield strength. The tensile strength of the grade A pipes is 48ksi and the maximum is 82 ksi for X70 grade. The API 5l psl2 pipe has slightly higher mechanical properties than the PSL1 pipes. The difference comes from chemical compositional difference and heat treatment. These pipe grades could be tested with bending test, flattening test and impact test types. The API 5l line pipe can be used in offshore oil drilling application, sour service application and in petroleum and oil and gas applications.

description: Grade X65 PSL1 Seamless Pipe is part of the API 5L pipes which are made according to the American Petroleum Institution standards. There are psl1 and psl2 product specification levels. The psl1 has grades A and B where the psl2 pipes come in various grades. The API 5L X65 Seamless Pipe has carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, vanadium and niobium with titanium in the composition. The material has 65ksi minimum yield strength 77ksi minimum tensile strength. The pipes range from ½ inches to 48 inches in seamless and ERW pipes. The welded pipes and LSAW pipes can range up to 100 inches in diameter and up to 12m in length. The wall thicknesses vary up to 250mm and the API 5l X65 PSL2 Steel Pipe schedules range from sch 20 through XXS accordingly. The material can be tested with impact tests and other tests.

The corrosion resistance and strength of the API 5L X65m Tubes make them available for oil and gas, high temperature and high pressure applications. These are used in petroleum, petrochemical, pharmaceuticals, power generation, nuclear power plants, heat exchangers and other high pressure temperature applications. The API 5L X65 Pipe can be used in larger diameter oil and gas lines that pass the fluids from the refineries to the stations. The material is a carbon steel and does not require preheating or post weld heat treatments. The pipes also come with different pipe end types such as beveled, plain or threaded based on the connection types used in the fixation of the pipes.

description: L485 Grade X70 PSL2 Seamless Pipe is part of a series of pipes that are under the API 5L specification. These are premium grade pipes that come under 2 product specification levels. The psl2 has slightly higher mechanical properties than the psl1. The X70 ERW Casing Pipe can be quenched or tempered for additional hardness. The pipes range up to 24 inches in outer diameter for the seamless pipes and up to 48 inches in welded pipes. The wall thickness of the pipes ranges up to sch160. This range covers the hot rolled seamless pipes and the cold drawn seamless pipes. There are also API 5L X70 Seamless Pipe types that are ERW, SAW and other type of manufacturing processes. The minimum yield strength of the pipes is at 70ksi and therefore they get the grading as X70.

The material has carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, vanadium, niobium and titanium in the composition and has high corrosion resistance. The API 5l grade X70 pipe is essentially a carbon steel made pipe that has high wear and tear resistance and toughness. These pipes are suitable to convey oil and gas for longer distances and therefore are used as line pipes. The API 5l gr. x70 psl-2 ERW Pipe is used in oil and gas, petrochemical, petroleum, pressure vessel and in other high temperature and high pressure applications. The pipes do not require pre heating and can be welded with most traditional welding methods without the need for filler materials.

description: API 5L ERW Pipe is a steel material, which is made up of manganese, copper, chromium, nickel, phosphorous, sulfur, and vanadium. The API 5L Erw Steel Pipe is made up of good strength and durability. These pipes are highly resistant to all forms of corrosion and have high stress-resistant. They are widely used in petrochemical industries, water supply systems, and oil and gas refineries. We are one of the top API 5L ERW Pipe manufacturers in India who focuses on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The Api 5l Welded Pipe is welded either spirally or longitudinally. These pipes have more roughness as compared to seamless pipes. They range in thickness from 2 inches to 24 inches in outer diameter. The API 5L Spiral Welded Pipes are produced from coils of steel. They are flattened and unwound by angled rollers into cylinders of required sizes. We manufacture all our products under strict supervision from our experienced and knowledgeable team members. Our team members use the best raw materials using the best technology following international and national standards.

The Fusion Bond Epoxy API 5L ERW Pipe is made of a resin and a polyamine hardener which are mixed and a chemical reaction takes place. This bonding is a strong and forms a rigid plastic coating. The coating on these pipes enables them to have good mechanical properties. These pipes also have a smooth surface allowing them to be easily cleaned and maintained. We also produce the 3LPE coated API 5L ERW Pipe which, can be customized like our other products into different shapes and sizes as per your requirements. If you have any queries regarding our products or pricing, contact us.

keyword_list: API 5l grade b carbon steel seamless pipe

description: API 5L Grade B Carbon Steel Seamless Pipe is made up of a carbon steel that consists of psl1 and psl2. These two product specification levels have their added mechanical properties. the grade comes as BN, Q, M, NS, QS or MS. The pipes could be produced as ERW, lsaw, ssaw or hsaw types. The outer diameter of the pipes ranges from 16 inches to 48 inches for lsaw pipes, up to 100 inches for ssaw or hsaw pipes and up to 24 inches for ERW pipes. The API 5L Grade B Schedule 40 Pipe API 5L Gr B Erw Pipe has wall thicknesses ranging up to 250mm with schedules ranging from sch20 through XXS and heavier.

The length of the pipes can range from single random, double random or custom cut to length sizes. The pipes can come with plain, beveled and treaded end types. The API 5l grade b line pipe can be coated with FBE, 3PE, black painting, varnish, anti rust oil and galvanized types. This grade of pipes have 415 MPa minimum tensile strength and 240 MPa minimum yield strength. The API 5l grade b psl 2 Pipe can be heat treated for additional strength. It could be rolled, normalizing rolled, normalizing formed, normalized, tempered and quenched, thermomechanical rolled or thermomechanical formed. These pipes are applicable on sour services and in oil and gas industrial applications to transport fluids for longer distances.

description: S355 grade is a low carbon and manganese steel alloy. The EN 10210 S355J2 Pipe is made up of this low carbon alloy. This pipe had properties that makes welding it possible at the same time, has good impact resistance. It can also be employed to be used in low temperatures. These pipes are used at MTR mass transit in railways, airports, and also as a transmission tower. The 0.22% of low carbon S355J2 Seamless Pipes are ductile, hard, strong, and is resistant to corrosion. The diameters of this seamless pipe vary from 4mm-219mm, while the wall thickness is between 0.5mm- 20mm. These pipes are not as hard as carbon steel pipes but due to carburizing these pipes have increased surface hardness. As a result, these pipes are used in critical structural applications. We provide the best EN 10210 S355J2 steel Pipe at reasonable rates.

The S355J2H EN 10210 Carbon Steel Pipes are used for mechanical as well as structural functions. Our workers ensure that the top quality raw materials are used, and the best pipes are produced which meet your requirements perfectly. Another low carbon pipe is the bs en 10210 s355j2h Welded Pipe. This pipe is also known as mild pipes. It has 017% carbon along with 140% manganese. This composition helps in welding the pipe as well as forming different shapes from this pipe.

The S355J2 Welded CHS Tube can be customized to your needs. These welded pipes are characterized by their strong construction and can withstand any pressures put on them. This pipe is quite reliable, affordable and has a superior finish.

description: ASTM A335 P11 PIPE has the composition of carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, silicon, chromium and molybdenum. The chromium molybdenum content makes the pipe corrosion resistant and strong. The material has 415MPa minimum tensile strength and 205MPa minimum yield strength. The ASTM A335 P11 Pipe comes in nominal bore sizes ranging from ½ inches to 36 inches. These are available in lengths up to 16000mm and wall thicknesses ranging from 2mm to 14mm. The SA335 GRADE P11 SEAMLESS PIPE can also be produced from schedule 20 through XXS and heavier with wall thicknesses up to 250mm for different application purposes. There are cold drawn and cold rolled pipe types in this grade of material. These are also known as drill pipes for their strength, toughness, wear resistance and the application in the oil drilling industrial applications.

A335 GRADE P11 DRILL PIPE can be made seamless, ERW, welded or fabricated. The shape of the pipe can be single random, double random and cut to length sizes. The pipe ends vary such as plain end, beveled end and treaded end types for these drill pipes. These are also known as larger diameter pipes. These ferritic alloy steel pipes are suitable for high temperature services. The A335 GR P11 ERW PIPE can be coated with color painting, 3LPE, epoxy resin and others. The forming operations such as drawing, expansion and machining are possible on these pipes. These can be hardened by full or isothermal heat treatment. The applications of these pipes are seen in spacecraft, turbine blades of jet engines and in nuclear reactors.

These pipes come with various surface finishes to avoid wear and tear and to improve corrosion resistance. The pipes can be machined, drawn, expanded or shot and sand blasted. The ASTM A335 P22 Pipe can also be normalized and tempered or full or isothermal annealed for maximum hardness. The applications of these pipes can be seen in the Pharmaceutical equipment, Chemical equipment, Sea water equipment, Heat exchangers, Condensers, Pulp and paper industry, Off-shore oil drilling companies, Power generation, Petrochemicals, Gas processing, Specialty chemicals and other industrial applications. There are seamless, welded, ERW and fabricated pipe types.

The pipes can be used in round, square, rectangular and hydraulic forms. The dimensions of the pipes vary according to the application requirements. The A335 P22 Welded Pipe can come in single random, double random or custom cut to length sizes and the pipe ends could be plain, beveled or treaded. These different end types help the pipes be fitted in different ways. The Alloy Steel P22 Chrome Moly Pipe can range from sch20 to XXS and heavier with wall thicknesses ranging from 2mm to 250mm. The outer diameter of the pipes can vary from 19.05mm to 114.3mm. The length of the pipes can be of 16000mm maximum. The SA355 P22 ERW Pipe has a minimum tensile strength of 415MPa and a minimum yield strength of 205MPa. These are also known as the chrome moly pipes because they have chromium, molybdenum in the composition with carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur and silicon in the composition.

Surface Finishes: Bare, Oiled, Mill Varnish, Galv, FBE, FBE Dual, 3LPE, 3LPP, Coal Tar, Concrete Coating and Tape Wrap.

Alloy Steel P5 Chrome Moly Pipe

description: SA 335 Grade P5 Alloy Steel Pipe is made up of an alloy steel that has chromium and molybdenum in high concentrations. The chromium content in these pipes is up to 10% and the molybdenum content in these pipes is up to 1.1%. This chemical composition provides the pipes with high mechanical strength and corrosion resistance. ASTM A335 P5 Pipe material includes carbon manganese phosphorus sulfur Silicon and chromium and molybdenum in the content. The grade 5 pipes have 415 MPA minimum tensile strength and 205 MPA minimum yield strength. The grade 5 pipes can be heat treated on the form of full or isothermal annealing. A335 P5B EFW Pipe can support to forming operations such as drawing, expansion, machining, sandblasting common short blasting, galvanizing and heat treatments.

The pipes can also be produced as rolled, cold drawn, normalizing rolled, thermomechanical rolled, formed, normalizing formed or quenched and tempered. Alloy Steel P5B Welded Pipes list precise in dimensions then the seamless pipes. The pipes can have plain ends or beveled ends. These pipes come under the AST M and ASM E standards. This standard specification covers pipes of diameters 3 by 8 inches to 30 inches in nominal bore sizes. The wall thickness of the pipes varies up to 250 millimeters with schedules varying up to XXS and heavier. Alloy Steel P5 Chrome Moly Pipe also ranges in size up to 13 meters in length and can be provided in custom cut to length sizes. The applications are seen mostly in the oil and gas industries and in the petroleum industrial applications.

Surface Finishes: Bare, Oiled, Mill Varnish, Galv, FBE, FBE Dual, 3LPE, 3LPP, Coal Tar, Concrete Coating and Tape Wrap.

description: SA335 Grade P9 Alloy Steel Pipe is made up of carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, silicon, chromium and molybdenum in the composition. This composition allows the material to be strong and corrosion resistance. The ASTM A335 P9 Pipe has 415MPa minimum tensile strength and 205MPa minimum yield strength. The pipes come under the ASTM and ASME specifications with diameters ranging from 19.05mm to 114.3mm. The wall thickness of the pipes range from 2mm to 14mm. There are welded, seamless, ERW and fabricated pipes. The A335 P9 Welded Pipe has single random, double random and custom cut to length sizes and it comes in round, square, rectangular and hydraulic pipe types. The pipes have plain, beveled and treaded end types for different fitting types.

The ASTM A335 P9 Alloy Steel Pipe is specialized in larger diameter pipes and is heat treated to gain more hardness. It could be full or isothermal annealed. The pipes can be have different finishes such as epoxy resin coating, color paint 3LPE coating and others. The material supports drawing, machining, sandblasting and other forming operations. The ASME SA335 Grade P9 ERW Pipe is used in industrial applications such as refineries, machine building, oil and gas, power generation, petrochemicals, gas processing, fertilizer, sugar and other industrial applications. These are suitable ferritic alloy steel pipes for high temperature service applications.

description: ASTM A335 P11 PIPE has the composition of carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, silicon, chromium and molybdenum. The chromium molybdenum content makes the pipe corrosion resistant and strong. The material has 415MPa minimum tensile strength and 205MPa minimum yield strength. The ASTM A335 P11 Pipe comes in nominal bore sizes ranging from ½ inches to 36 inches. These are available in lengths up to 16000mm and wall thicknesses ranging from 2mm to 14mm. The SA335 GRADE P11 SEAMLESS PIPE can also be produced from schedule 20 through XXS and heavier with wall thicknesses up to 250mm for different application purposes. There are cold drawn and cold rolled pipe types in this grade of material. These are also known as drill pipes for their strength, toughness, wear resistance and the application in the oil drilling industrial applications.

A335 GRADE P11 DRILL PIPE can be made seamless, ERW, welded or fabricated. The shape of the pipe can be single random, double random and cut to length sizes. The pipe ends vary such as plain end, beveled end and treaded end types for these drill pipes. These are also known as larger diameter pipes. These ferritic alloy steel pipes are suitable for high temperature services. The A335 GR P11 ERW PIPE can be coated with color painting, 3LPE, epoxy resin and others. The forming operations such as drawing, expansion and machining are possible on these pipes. These can be hardened by full or isothermal heat treatment. The applications of these pipes are seen in spacecraft, turbine blades of jet engines and in nuclear reactors.

description: P22 Alloy Steel Round Pipe is a larger diameter pipe that is used in high temperature services. These pipes come with various surface finishes to avoid wear and tear and to improve corrosion resistance. The pipes can be machined, drawn, expanded or shot and sand blasted. The ASTM A335 P22 Pipe can also be normalized and tempered or full or isothermal annealed for maximum hardness. The applications of these pipes can be seen in the Pharmaceutical equipment, Chemical equipment, Sea water equipment, Heat exchangers, Condensers, Pulp and paper industry, Off-shore oil drilling companies, Power generation, Petrochemicals, Gas processing, Specialty chemicals and other industrial applications. There are seamless, welded, ERW and fabricated pipe types.

The pipes can be used in round, square, rectangular and hydraulic forms. The dimensions of the pipes vary according to the application requirements. The A335 P22 Welded Pipe can come in single random, double random or custom cut to length sizes and the pipe ends could be plain, beveled or treaded. These different end types help the pipes be fitted in different ways. The Alloy Steel P22 Chrome Moly Pipe can range from sch20 to XXS and heavier with wall thicknesses ranging from 2mm to 250mm. The outer diameter of the pipes can vary from 19.05mm to 114.3mm. The length of the pipes can be of 16000mm maximum. The SA355 P22 ERW Pipe has a minimum tensile strength of 415MPa and a minimum yield strength of 205MPa. These are also known as the chrome moly pipes because they have chromium, molybdenum in the composition with carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur and silicon in the composition.

Surface Finishes: Bare, Oiled, Mill Varnish, Galv, FBE, FBE Dual, 3LPE, 3LPP, Coal Tar, Concrete Coating and Tape Wrap.
End Finishes: Beveled, Square Cut, Threaded & Coupled.

The high chromium content and the other alloy elements in the composition make the ASTM A335 P91 Pipe is stronger and corrosion resistant. The pipe has 585MPa minimum tensile strength and 425 MPa minimum yield strength. The material has good corrosion resistance, temperature resistance and pressure capacities. The pipe could be made as ERW, EFW or welded or fabricated. The seamless pipes are more dimensionally accurate that the A335 P91 Welded Pipe and are used in precision applications.

There are different pipe ends such as the beveled, plain and treaded end types. The pipes also come in square, rectangular and hydraulic types in addition to the round pipes. The pipes could range from ½ inches to 36 inches in nominal bore size, the wall thickness could range up to 250mm with schedules ranging up to XXS and heavier and the lengths can be single random, double random or custom cut to length sizes. The applications of the Sch40 P91 Alloy Steel Pipe are mostly in the power generation, gas processing, oil services, petrochemical plants, boilers and in the heater and reheater applications.

description: astm a53 grade b erw pipe is made up of electric resistance weld procedure. The pipe has grades A and B and the grade B has slightly higher mechanical properties than grade A. The ASTM A53 Grade B Pipe composition includes carbon, manganese, phosphorus, sulfur, copper, nickel, chromium, molybdenum and vanadium. The material composition provides the pipes with 330MPa minimum tensile strength and 205MPa minimum yield strength for grade A while giving 415MPa minimum tensile strength and 240MPa minimum yield strength for grade B. The pipes can range from 1/8 inches to 26 inches in outer diameter with wall thicknesses varying up to 250mm. This combination provides the steel a53 grade b pipe with high pressure capacities with schedules varying from sch10 through 160, XH and XXH.

This specification of pipes are intended for mechanical pressure applications but they can also be used in general corrosive services such as gas, air lines, water, steam and others. The material supports most forming operations such as volving coiling, bending, flanging and other machining operations. The asme sa53 grade b schedule 80 pipe is one of the medium pressure class pipes. It could be used in oil and gas, pressure vessel, power generation, automobile and other applications. The astm a53 grade b type e pipe is a welded black and hot dip galvanized pipe that is electric resistantly made by welding. The pipe is one of the recommendations for pressure piping.

description: Sour service can be defined as an exploration into environments producing oil, which contains enough H2S that, will ultimately cause cracking of metallic materials. Sour service pipe is used in environments having high corrosion resistance. Materials For Sour Service Pipeline include silicon, sulfur, carbon, phosphorous, manganese, titanium, vanadium, niobium, and elements in smaller quantities. This process should keep in mind the entire design process of the project, cost, maintenance, safety, risks, and environmental effects. We are proud to be the leading manufacturers of sour service pipe, and our ultimate aim is to produce high-quality products at reasonable rates.

Sour service drill pipe is used in well drilling applications. These pipes can either be welded or be seamless in formation. As the drilling process intensifies the possibility of hitting H2S increases. This may, in turn, lead to hydrogen-induced cracking in this sour environment. However, the presence of the sour service pipeline ensures that the hydrogen is kept under check and improves the mechanical properties of the line. These pipes are carbon steel pipes that are customized for sour services. The tensile strength of these pipes ranges from 415 MPa to 760 MPa and the yield strength is from 245 MPa- 635 MPa depending on the grade of the pipes.

The carbon steel pipe for sour service comes in 3/8 inches to 30 inches with different coatings. They are treated for heat and sub-zero temperatures. The seamless API 5L grade B pipe is mostly preferred; in sour gas services. Due to the acute shortage of the above pipe ERW, pipes are used as a replacement. The erw sour service has so far been able to control the service as long as quality control is maintained.

description: Drilling is a process wherein a drill bit is used to punch a hole into a solid surface. Drill pipes are used to drill into hard surfaces. This pipes are made up of aluminium or steel and is hollow in nature which allows the drilling fluid to be pumped in it. Drill Pipe Grades are of 3 types based on wall strength, impact strength, and yield strength. It is generally 27-32 feet in length. We are one of the biggest drill pipe manufacturers in India. Our main goal is to provide high-quality products at reasonable rates.

This oilfield pipe has rods that are designed using the best raw material ensuring, extra strength as well as sustainability. Drilling Rods make the largest; component of a drill pipe. The main function of these rods is to enable rotatory motion as well as a flushing medium to the bit. The API Drill Rods are made up of seamless steel tubes and fitted with alloy steel joints. These rods can be customized to different shapes. These Heavy Wall Drill Pipe rods are used in rigs to drop the DTH hammer underground.

The Xt57 Drill Pipe has 70% more torque compared to an API pipe. These pipes are 5-8 inches in outer diameter and are mostly connected to the pipe to transmit the torque while drilling. The Xt39 Drill Pipe on the other hand can be used to dig borewells. It is mostly used in oil rigs for production purposes and drilling. With a tensile strength of 135,000, the S-135 drill pipe is a high-strength drill pipe. It has the capacity to drill rocks deep down at high-stress levels.

The ASTM A213 Grade T11 Boiler Tube can be coated with resins, paint or 3LPE coating to avoid corrosion, wear and tear. These pipes are made for high temperature service applications. The seamless pipes are more accurate in dimensions and could be used in equipment. description: Alloy Steel A213 Grade T91 Seamless Tubes are high strength, corrosion resistant ferritic alloy tubes that are intended for high temperature services. The material consists of carbon, silicon, manganese, nickel, phosphorus, chromium, sulfur, molybdenum, vanadium, niobium, nitrogen, aluminum, titanium and zirconium in the composition. The ASTM A213 T91 Tube gets the strength from this composition. The tubes have 585 MPa minimum tensile strength and 415 MPa minimum yield strength with 20% elongation at break. The dimensions vary from tube to pipe and can range from 1m to 12m in length. The standard schedules apply with wall thicknesses ranging from 1mm to 200mm. The ASTM A213 T91 Seamless Tubes are available in seamless, ERW, welded or fabricated forms with round, square, rectangular and hydraulic shapes.

The tube ends could be beveled, plain or treaded to suit different types of fittings in various applications. The seamless tubes are precise where the T91 Chrome Moly Welded Tube is also used very commonly. The application of the material could be seen in power generation plants, chemical processing plants, refineries and other high temperature, high pressure applications. The SA213 Gr T91 Seamless Tubing allying elements such as the zirconium and titanium improve the corrosion resistance of the material and also the strength. These are long lasting pipes but are expensive compared to the lower grades in the ASME SA213 specification.

Surface Finishes: Bare, Galv, FBE, FBE Dual, Oiled, Mill Varnish, 3LPE, 3LPP, Coal Tar, Concrete Coating and Tape Wrap.

description: T22 Chrome Moly Welded Tube slightly higher molybdenum content of 0.87% than the T12 grade of this specification. The composition has carbon, silicon, manganese, phosphorus, up to 2.6% chromium, sulfur and molybdenum as well. The ASTM A213 T22 Tube have 415 MPa minimum tensile strength and 205 MPa minimum yield strength. There are equivalent grades such as the ASTM a209. The popes are specialized in larger diameters but range from 6.35mm to 101.6mm in outer diameter. The wall thicknesses range from 1mm to 200mm and the length can be single random, double random and custom cut to length sizes up to 12m. The Alloy Steel A213 Grade T22 Seamless Tubes are eighter cold drawn or cold rolled. There are seamless, ERW, welded and fabricated types.

The shape of the pipes and tubes range as round, square, rectangular and hydraulic according to the different application requirements. The pipes can come with beveled end, plain end or treaded end types. The ASTM A213 Grade T22 Round Tube is the most commonly used in applications such as the power generation plants, petrochemical applications, refineries and other high pressure, high temperature applications. These tubes are intended for high temperature services. The ASME SA213 T22 Welded Tube can be coated with epoxy resin, color painting or 3LPE coating. It can support forming operations such as drawing, expansion, machining, sand blasting or galvanizing. The material can be heat treated for additional strength as well.

description: Alloy Steel A213 Grade T91 Seamless Tubes are high strength, corrosion resistant ferritic alloy tubes that are intended for high temperature services. The material consists of carbon, silicon, manganese, nickel, phosphorus, chromium, sulfur, molybdenum, vanadium, niobium, nitrogen, aluminum, titanium and zirconium in the composition. The ASTM A213 T91 Tube gets the strength from this composition. The tubes have 585 MPa minimum tensile strength and 415 MPa minimum yield strength with 20% elongation at break. The dimensions vary from tube to pipe and can range from 1m to 12m in length. The standard schedules apply with wall thicknesses ranging from 1mm to 200mm. The ASTM A213 T91 Seamless Tubes are available in seamless, ERW, welded or fabricated forms with round, square, rectangular and hydraulic shapes.

The tube ends could be beveled, plain or treaded to suit different types of fittings in various applications. The seamless tubes are precise where the T91 Chrome Moly Welded Tube is also used very commonly. The application of the material could be seen in power generation plants, chemical processing plants, refineries and other high temperature, high pressure applications. The SA213 Gr T91 Seamless Tubing allying elements such as the zirconium and titanium improve the corrosion resistance of the material and also the strength. These are long lasting pipes but are expensive compared to the lower grades in the ASME SA213 specification.

Surface Finishes: Bare, Galv, FBE, FBE Dual, Oiled, Mill Varnish, 3LPE, 3LPP, Coal Tar, Concrete Coating and Tape Wrap.
End Finishes: Beveled, Square Cut, Threaded & Coupled.

description: Hastelloy is a nickel, chromium, and molybdenum alloy. The Hastelloy C276 Pipe has excellent corrosion resistance in different types of environments. The presence of high molybdenum in these pipes makes them highly resistant to pitting and crevice corrosion. Precipitation hardening, solid-solution hardening, and work hardening methods can be used to strengthen these pipes. This pipe is widely used in paper, pulp industries, pollution control, chemical industries, and waste management systems. Over the last decade, we have been the leading manufacturer and supplier of Hastelloy C276 Pipe. We ensure that the products we produce are top quality and available at reasonable rates to all.

The ASTM B622 UNS N10276 Seamless Tube is manufactured in a solution under annealed and descaled condition. These pipes have good tensile strength, yield strength, and excellent elongation properties. These tubes can be customized or grooved as per your specifications. The low carbon concentration in these pipes reduces the formation of carbide precipitation at the time of welding. The Nickel C276 Welded Pipe is therefore resistant to the formation of grain boundary on the welded areas. As a result of all of this, the C276 Alloy Round Pipe is suited for different types of chemical reactions.

The Schedule 40 UNS N10276 Boiler Tube is used to transfer heat from one substance to the other. These tubes are designed to withstand extreme temperatures without deforming. The Nickel C276 Heat Exchanger Tube is another example of these types of heavy-duty tubes we manufacture. These tubes have great; thermal stability as they are treated under 2050 degree F followed by water quenching and rapid air-cooling.

description: Monel is made up of a group of alloys predominantly of nickel and copper and containing a few small portions of iron, manganese, silicon, and carbon. The Monel 400 pipe has good tensile strength and has elongation properties. The materials used in the preparation of this pipe make it stronger than steel and resistant to corrosion. It is used in processing equipment, valves, pumps, shafts, fittings, and fasteners. We are one of the top manufacturers and distributors of Monel 400 pipe, and our main focus is creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASME SB163 UNS N04400 Heat Exchanger Tube can withstand extreme temperatures. They are produced using the best raw material using the latest technology to ensure that they don’t deform under any kind of pressure. Another heat-resistant alloy of Monel is the ASTM B163 UNS N04400 Seamless Boiler Tube. These tubes have great thermal stability and are used in industrial processing plants, power generation, fossil fuel plants, etc. The UNS N04400 Condensor Tube has good ductility and corrosion resistance at elevated temperatures. These condenser tubes transmit thermal energy from a hotter liquid or gas to a colder liquid or gas.

A seamless Monel pipe has possibilities of being corroded. The Nickel 400 Alloy Welded Pipe completely irradiates the possibility of corrosion and erosion. This provides the pipe with additional strength at the same time improves opportunities for fabrication. We also produce a Schedule 40 Monel 400 Seamless Pipe which, is used for heavy-duty applications. All our tubes and pipes can be grooved, cut according to your needs.
